title: Reset Ready
style: Pop-rap sports anthem with crisp mid-tempo bounce, syncopated handclaps, and a punchy backbeat; verse stays in live-commentary POV with quick teaching lines, pre-chorus narrows to a tense reset setup, chorus lands on a chantable hook with gang vocals and short ad-lib shouts. Vocal is close-mic and confident, with doubled hook lines, sidechain swells into the chorus, crowd-style commentator interjections, and bright, glossy mix with clean high-end snap.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Live on the line,
I’m watching your feet
Soft hands, low paddle,
one beat, then repeat

Take that heat off,
let it die at the net
Set the ball dead,
that’s the safest bet

Commentator’s talking,
“Look at that touch!”
Coach in the corner like,
“Yeah, that’s enough”

One calm block,
then I point and say
“Reset it back,
now build your way”

[Pre-Chorus]
Bend your knees
Hold your ground
Small target now
Keep it down

Eyes up front
No panic, no rush
Make ’em lift it
That’s the crush

[Chorus]
Reset ready (reset ready)
Soft hands, steady (soft hands, steady)
Reset ready (reset ready)
Make it look easy

Reset ready (reset ready)
Net tape friendly (net tape friendly)
Reset ready (reset ready)
Point by point, please

[Verse 2]
Now turn that defense
into a clean reply
One step in,
then let it glide

Quiet wrist,
let the paddle stay true
Pro to student,
I’m handing you clues

See that smile?
That’s a winning shot
Commentator yelling,
“Coach taught a lot!”

From my POV,
I know what you need
Slow it down,
then plant that seed

[Pre-Chorus]
Bend your knees
Hold your ground
Small target now
Keep it down

Eyes up front
No panic, no rush
Make ’em lift it
That’s the crush

[Chorus]
Reset ready (reset ready)
Soft hands, steady (soft hands, steady)
Reset ready (reset ready)
Make it look easy

Reset ready (reset ready)
Net tape friendly (net tape friendly)
Reset ready (reset ready)
Point by point, please

[Bridge]
Watch the arc
Watch the drop
Let it hang
Then make it stop

One more cue,
now you own the lane
Coach to student
Again and again

[Final Chorus]
Reset ready (reset ready)
Soft hands, steady (soft hands, steady)
Reset ready (reset ready)
Make it look easy

Reset ready (reset ready)
Net tape friendly (net tape friendly)
Reset ready (reset ready)
Point by point, please
